content.short: Hacken is a premier security auditor for Web3, offering expert smart contract reviews and bug bounties for TON.
content.description: Hacken is a leading cybersecurity firm focused on blockchain and Web3 security. It offers a comprehensive suite of services for the TON ecosystem, including smart contract audits, blockchain protocol security assessments, and the management of bug bounty programs through HackenProof. With its deep expertise and commitment to transparency, Hacken helps TON developers mitigate risks and secure their decentralized applications, providing the necessary assurance for users and investors in the fast-growing TON market.
content.meta: Ensure the safety of your TON dApp with Hacken's expert audits. Leading Web3 security on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
